description.zh: 需要修改信息的互动消息应用ID。
description.en: The ID of the interactive messaging application whose content moderation settings you want to modify.

description.zh:
安全审核方式。取值：
- 0：不进行安全审核
- 1：内置安全审核
- 2：自定义安全审核
description.en:
The content moderation method. Valid values:

*   0: disables content moderation.
*   1: uses built-in content moderation.
*   2: uses custom content moderation.

description.zh: 如果是自定义安全审核（AuditType=2），则需要提供安全审核的地址。安全审核地址以http://或https://开头，不包含私有IP，不允许带端口号。
description.en: The URL for content moderation. This parameter is required if you set AuditType to 2. The URL must start with http:// or https:// and cannot contain a private IP address or a port number.

description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center. It must be the same as the data center that was specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~) operation to create the interactive messaging application. Valid values: cn-shanghai and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

title.zh: 修改直播互动应用鉴权信息

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-message-app-audit --app-id demo --audit-type 2 --audit-url http://example.aliyundoc.com/exampleaudit --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
